messages:
Sam: Tiny midweek shoutout to Rhea and Omar who helped debug the meeting-room mic and left a note on the AV board so we don't repeat yesterday's echo-symphony. Absolute legends. :pray:

Rhea: That mic was haunted. We unplugged, breathed, and also sacrificed one sticky note. :ghost::sticky_note:

Omar: Also shoutout to Priya for bringing spare batteries and Max for being on coffee duty while we wrestled cables. Team effort. :coffee:

Priya: Batteries: check. Pro tip: keep a small pouch labeled 'AV bits' in the cupboard. Saves 15 minutes and a lot of apologies.

Max: Happy to fuel the rescue. If we start an "AV rescue" rota I will bring donuts on my shift. :doughnut:

Asha: Love the idea of a tiny gratitude wall. Can we put a magnet board by the fridge? One-line kudos, date, and optional emoji. Low effort, high joy.

kudos-bot: +1 Rhea, +1 Omar, +1 Priya. Thread pinned to #random for 24h. :tada:

Sam: Agree on the magnet board. Also documenting: "If you save the meeting, leave a sweet." Official policy? :smile: Thanks again everyone, the demo went much better after the fix.
